xmldoc.short_description: Checks whether a preference group or preferences exist.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or scalar string: the group name. It must be a valid variable name.
a character vector or scalar string: one preference name, or a cell array of character vectors or a string array: several preference names. Each name must be a valid variable name.

param_output_item.param_description: a logical scalar, or a logical array with the same size as pref when several names are given.

description.p: tf = ispref(group) returns true when the preference group exists, and false otherwise.

tf = ispref(group, pref) returns true when the preference exists in the group. With several names, the result is a logical array with one element for each name. A missing group gives false for every name and does not raise an error.
An error is raised when a group or preference name is not a valid variable name.

example_item.example_item_description: Check for a group and for several preferences, then remove the group.
